Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Rishabh - 8 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Hema - 37 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
3. Vikram - 44 years, father
Look: blue shirt, black trousers
4. Aditi - 10 years, daughter
Look: glasses, blue dress

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Rishabh stands in the courtyard. Hema and Vikram stand near him.]

Vikram: "Hema, what's the plan today?"

[Rishabh runs to Mother.]

Rishabh (softly): "This is amazing!"

[Rishabh jumps with joy.]

Rishabh: "Yes, of course."

[Rishabh climbs the stairs to the terrace.]

Rishabh: "I'm ready!"

[Rishabh hides behind the tree.]

Hema: "How beautiful!"

[Rishabh searches for his lost ball.]

Rishabh: "Mom, listen!"

[Rishabh peeks out from behind the door.]

Rishabh (softly): "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
